prompts.prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: background for the Vietnamese pixel art dress-up game Tiệm May Nếp, workbench-ui--landscape. Generate one polished LANDSCAPE 16:9 pixel art background, no mockup borders. A warm traditional Vietnamese tailor atelier inside a Bắc Bộ timber house: dark lim wood posts and exposed beams, aged lime plaster, terracotta brick flooring, wooden lattice windows at far left letting in warm morning sunlight, bamboo blind, shelves of neatly rolled Vietnamese silk in chàm indigo, đỏ điều red, hoàng yến yellow and giấy dó cream, modest blue-and-white ceramic vase with lotus, brass tailor shears and a wooden measuring ruler hanging at far margins. Subtle lotus and woven silk border motifs in carved joinery, avoid generic pan-Asian design. COMPOSITION CRITICAL: left half contains a low circular wooden fitting podium centered around x=27%, y=77%, with completely empty space above it for a separate full-body paperdoll; right half contains an unobstructed quiet lime-plaster/wood backdrop for an overlay tab panel, shelves only at far right edge. Preserve all focal objects within the central 90% image height to allow 16:9 to 8:5 crop. Environment only, no people, no mannequin, no clothing figures, no text or symbols pretending to be text, no baked buttons or UI, no flags, no dragons, no Chinese/Japanese temple gates or red lantern strings. Pixel art intended for a final 800x500 logical grid; crisp square pixels, limited earthy 32-color appearance, hard edges, tasteful dithering, no smooth gradients, no anti-aliasing, no photographic rendering. Enough clear negative space for UI while visibly a Vietnamese craft atelier. Output one complete background.
